visual_name: Day in the life, part forty two: the wall (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js basement (cut away at the front: concrete floor, grey block walls, one beige painted wall he films in front of, ceiling beams and pipes, a beam that sags, falling dust, a boiler, shelves of boxes, stairs, a bare bulb, an old green couch, a tripod), googly eyes and a talking mouth that appear on the wall, an I WANT ROYALTIES sticky note, box-built creator with a blond buzz cut, freckles, an orange hoodie, grey sweatpants and slides with socks, a blue cap for his second character, phone sheets for his grid of forty one identical videos / the brand's 'try something new' / the YourBrand Content Style Guide (ten styles, When to use it) / his grid now, every style, the wall in each, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.3 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: in a basement, every video he makes is the same: him, talking, at the same beige wall, forty one videos, one wall. The brand asks for something new, so he tries to move the wall; it is load-bearing, and he ends up holding the ceiling up. Then YourBrand: the Content Style Guide, ten styles and when to use each one (POV, unboxing, tutorials, skits); he does a skit, plays both characters, and one of them is the wall. The wall is in every video now. It wants royalties.
